title: CFAR Detector
text: Constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detector, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {CFAR algorithm} sets CFAR algorithm; {Number of guard cells}, {Number of training cells}, {Rank of order statistic}, {Threshold factor method} sets the methods of obtaining threshold factor, {Probability of false alarm} sets the desired probability of false alarm, {Custom threshold factor}, {Output format} sets the format of detection results, {Output detection threshold}, {Output estimated noise power}, {Source of the number of detections}, {Maximum number of detections} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Cell matrix real-valued M -by-1 column vector | real-valued M -by- N matrix

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Index of cells under test real-valued length- D vector

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Detection results D -by-1 vector | D -by- N matrix | 1 -by- L | 2-by- L matrix

params.name: CFAR algorithm
params.values: CFAR algorithm CA (default) | GOCA | SOCA | OS

params.name: Threshold factor method
params.values: Methods of obtaining threshold factor Auto (default) | Input port | Custom

params.name: Output format
params.values: Format of detection results CUT result (default) | Detection index

params.name: Output estimated noise power
params.values: Output estimated noise power off (default) | on

params.name: Source of the number of detections
params.values: Source of the number of detections Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Maximum number of detections
params.values: Maximum number of detections to report 1 (default)

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
